'''Tian Ye''' or '''Ye Tian''' ({{lang-zh|c=田野}}; born November 1971) is a Chinese mathematician known for his research in [[number theory]] and [[arithmetic geometry]]. He is a professor of mathematics at the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] and is the deputy director of its Morningside Center of Mathematics.

==Early life and education==
Tian Ye was born in [[Neijiang]], [[Sichuan]], China in November 1971.<ref name="academician-profile">{{cite web |url=https://casad.cas.cn/ysxx2022/ysmd/sxwl/202312/t20231205_4990220.html |title=田野 |language=zh |website=[[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=30 May 2024}}</ref> From 1989 to 1996, he studied at [[Sichuan University]] where he received his B.S. and M.S.<ref name="home"/> He received his Ph.D. in mathematics under [[Shou-Wu Zhang]] at [[Columbia University]] in 2003.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=77687}}</ref> He was a member at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] from 2003 to 2004.<ref name="SCU"/>

==Career==
Tian was a post-doctoral researcher at [[McGill University]] from 2004 to 2006.<ref name="home"/> He has been a professor at the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] since 2006.<ref name="home">{{cite web |url=http://www.mcm.ac.cn/faculty/tianye/201409/t20140916_255888.html |title=Tian Ye (田野) |website=Morningside Center of Mathematics, Chinese Academy of Sciences |access-date=30 May 2024}}</ref><ref name="SCU"/> He is the deputy director of the Morningside Center of Mathematics.<ref name="MCM-directors">{{cite web |url=http://www.mcm.ac.cn/about/directors/ |title=Directors |website=Morningside Center of Mathematics, Chinese Academy of Sciences |access-date=30 May 2024}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Tian received the [[ICTP Ramanujan Prize]] (2013) and the [[Morningside Medal]] (Silver 2007, Gold 2013).<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.ams.org/notices/201402/rnoti-p195.pdf|title=Ye Tian Awarded 2013 ICTP/IMU Ramanujan Prize|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|department=Mathematics People|date=February 2014|page=195|volume=61|issue=2}}.</ref><ref>[http://english.amss.cas.cn/ns/es/201307/t20130725_106888.html Prof.Ye TIAN Honored with the Morningside Medal of Mathematics], Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, retrieved 2015-05-06.</ref> He was elected a [[List of members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences|member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2023.<ref name="academician-profile"/><ref name="SCU">{{cite web |url=https://math.scu.edu.cn/info/1061/10872.htm |title=热烈祝贺我院89级校友田野教授当选中国科学院院士 |language=zh |website=[[Sichuan University]] |date=28 November 2023 |access-date=30 May 2024}}</ref>

He was an [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2022.<ref name="SCU"/>
